title: A Cipher for the Asset
author: Silas Whitlock
blurb: Odile Crane, a whistle-blower living under four names, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
